findings.desc: doc-code-drift: evidence file line 12 says `authority-client-role.md` is "not yet created" but the file is committed in the same diff. Stale draft note in the derivation artifact confuses future readers about whether the canonical truth source exists.

doc-code-drift: evidence file §"What the CLI does NOT have yet" (lines 112–113) lists handshake fields in snake_case (`client_name`, `client_version`, `command_catalog_digest`, `evidence_schema_digest`, `authority_mode`) while the canonical doc and the evidence file's own §Python authority section both consistently use camelCase (`clientName`, `clientVersion`, `commandCatalogDigest`, `evidenceSchemaDigest`, `authorityMode`). Creates naming ambiguity between the CLI (camelCase) and Python server (snake_case) perspectives.
